# Intelligence Dossier: sentence-transformers

Identified mean pooling temporal invariant with attention mask clamp.

candidateRules.title: Clamped Masked Temporal Pooling (CMTP)
candidateRules.content: When pooling transformer token representations, clamp attention mask sum divisor to min 1e-9 to prevent NaN division.
candidateRules.summary: Transformer pooling with epsilon divisor clamp preventing division by zero.
candidateRules.actionable_instruction: Calculate sum_mask = torch.clamp(mask.sum(1), min=1e-9) before division.
